campaign.zh: 活动；为目标组织的一系列行动
campaign.usageNote: 可数名词，为实现一个目标而安排的一系列活动；这里包括贴告示、分发传单和收集居民意见。
campaign.example: Their campaign includes a notice, leaflets and conversations with local residents.
campaign.exampleZh: 他们的活动包括告示、传单和与当地居民交流。
campaign.provenance: External evidence · Princeton WordNet3.0; Researcher inference · contextual selection, Chinese and original examples

distribute.usageNote: 及物动词，分发。distribute leaflets to people表示把传单分给人们。
distribute.example: Sam will distribute the leaflets to people leaving the library.
distribute.exampleZh: 萨姆将把传单分给离开图书馆的人。
distribute.provenance: External evidence · Princeton WordNet3.0; Researcher inference · contextual selection, Chinese and original examples

adopt.usageNote: 及物动词，开始采用一种方法；这里改用具体问题收集意见。
adopt.example: They adopt a different way of collecting comments.
adopt.exampleZh: 他们采用另一种收集意见的方法。

contrasts.example: They adopt a new way of collecting comments.

contrasts.example: The couple decided to adopt a child.
contrasts.exampleZh: 这对夫妇决定收养一个孩子。

identify.usageNote: 及物动词，认出或确定某人是谁；这里凭标明姓名和Chair的卡片找到会议主持人。
identify.example: The name card marked “Chair” helps Nina identify the person chairing the meeting.
identify.exampleZh: 标有“Chair（主持人）”的姓名卡帮助妮娜认出主持会议的人。
identify.provenance: External evidence · Princeton WordNet3.0; Researcher inference · contextual selection, Chinese and original examples

assess.usageNote: 及物动词，评估或判断情况及影响；这里比较长椅原位置和建议位置对人行道使用者的影响。
assess.example: The members need to assess how the present and suggested locations would affect people using the pavement.
assess.exampleZh: 议员们需要评估原位置和建议位置会怎样影响使用人行道的人。
assess.provenance: External evidence · Princeton WordNet3.0; Researcher inference · contextual selection, Chinese and original examples

outcome.usageNote: 可数名词，行动或事件的结果；这里长椅是否修复或移动仍待决定。
outcome.example: They will tell the neighbours the outcome after the council has made its decision.
outcome.exampleZh: 议会作出决定后，他们会把结果告诉邻居。
